Common protocols:
• Pellet TRT Protocol: Testosterone pellets per physician protocol, HCG 250-500IU 2-3x/week (fertility preservation), Anastrozole if E2 elevation confirmed on labs

Monitoring: Total T, Free T, E2, Hematocrit at 4 weeks post-insertion and at trough (just before next insertion). PSA annually. Insertion site monitoring for infection or extrusion.

Regulatory status: FDA APPROVED — Testopel. Requires physician procedure. Compounded pellets also widely available through BHRT practices.

entries.title: Glycine and NAC (GlyNAC)
entries.subtitle: GlyNAC, glycine plus NAC combination
entries.text:
Glycine and NAC (GlyNAC) (GlyNAC, glycine plus NAC combination) — Longevity Supplements

GlyNAC refers to the combination of Glycine and NAC (N-Acetyl Cysteine) taken together — providing all three precursors for glutathione synthesis (glycine, cysteine via NAC, and glutamine which is typically sufficient). A landmark 2021 Baylor College of Medicine clinical trial in older adults demonstrated GlyNAC supplementation for 24 weeks corrected multiple aging deficits: increased glutathione by 94%, improved mitochondrial function, reduced oxidative stress, improved insulin resistance, corrected genomic damage, and improved muscle strength, gait speed, and cognitive function. One of the most impressive human longevity trial results published. Both compounds are inexpensive and widely available.

Reported benefits:
• 24-week human RCT showing correction of multiple aging deficits simultaneously
• 94% increase in glutathione levels
• Improved mitochondrial function, muscle strength, gait speed, cognition in one study
• Both compounds inexpensive and widely available
• Addresses glutathione deficiency — near-universal in aging
• Glycine additionally supports sleep and collagen synthesis

Risks and trade-offs:
• Single trial at one institution — needs replication
• Baylor trial used specific doses — don't assume other doses have same effect
• NAC regulatory status uncertain as supplement in US
• GI sensitivity to NAC at higher doses
• Glycine and NAC should be taken together for synergistic glutathione effect
• Long-term effects beyond 24 weeks not yet fully characterized

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Baylor trial protocol: Glycine 1.33g/kg + NAC 0.81g/kg per day — Split 2-3x daily oral (Ongoing)
• Practical standard: Glycine 5-10g + NAC 1200-1800mg daily — Split doses with food (Ongoing)

Progression: The Baylor trial used weight-based dosing — a 180lb man would take roughly 10.8g glycine and 6.6g NAC daily. This is higher than typical supplement use. A practical approach is 5-10g glycine and 1200-1800mg NAC daily as a compromise between trial doses and tolerability.

Common protocols:
• GlyNAC Longevity Protocol: Glycine 5-10g/day split doses, NAC 1200mg 2x/day, Vitamin C 1000mg/day (glutathione recycling), Alpha-Lipoic Acid 300mg/day (antioxidant synergy)

Monitoring: Inflammatory markers (CRP), fasting glucose and insulin (insulin sensitivity improvement), energy and strength self-assessment. Glutathione levels if specialty labs are available.

Regulatory status: Both are dietary supplements. NAC regulatory status in US uncertain — sold as supplement. Well-evidenced combination.

entries.title: Melatonin (Therapeutic)
entries.subtitle: High-dose melatonin, Pierpaoli protocol
entries.text:
Melatonin (Therapeutic) (High-dose melatonin, Pierpaoli protocol) — Longevity Supplements

Melatonin is far more than a sleep hormone. Research led by Walter Pierpaoli and others demonstrates melatonin is a master antioxidant, mitochondrial protectant, and regulator of the aging process via its action on the pineal gland and circadian system. Standard sleep doses are 0.5-1mg. Therapeutic longevity protocols use 10-100mg — doses that show anticancer properties, mitochondrial protection, immune enhancement, and anti-inflammatory effects beyond sleep induction. At higher doses melatonin scavenges free radicals more effectively than Vitamin E or C. Growing use in integrative oncology and longevity medicine. The standard OTC dose of 5-10mg is actually pharmacologically high — 0.3mg is physiologically normal.

Reported benefits:
• Powerful antioxidant — scavenges free radicals directly
• Mitochondrial membrane protector
• Anticancer properties in research (particularly breast, prostate)
• Immune modulation and enhancement
• Regulates circadian rhythm and pineal function
• Inexpensive — widely available in high doses

Risks and trade-offs:
• High doses may cause morning grogginess
• Can suppress endogenous melatonin production at high doses
• Theoretical concern about reproductive hormones at very high doses
• Most high-dose human data from cancer contexts
• Not recommended during pregnancy
• Interacts with anticoagulants — check with physician

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Sleep optimization: 0.3-1mg — Oral 30-60 min before bed (Ongoing — avoid higher doses for sleep)
• Therapeutic longevity: 10-60mg — Oral at bedtime (Ongoing — physician guided)
• Anticancer adjunct: 20-40mg — Oral at bedtime (Physician supervised protocol)

Progression: For sleep use the lowest effective dose (0.3-1mg) — higher doses don't improve sleep and may worsen grogginess. For longevity and therapeutic use, higher doses (10-100mg) are a different application with different rationale. Slow-release preferred for longevity protocols.

Common protocols:
• Longevity and Sleep: Melatonin 10-20mg slow-release at bedtime, DSIP 300mcg SubQ pre-bed (complementary), Glycine 5g pre-bed, Epithalon pulse cycles (pineal support)

Monitoring: Morning energy levels (avoid grogginess at current dose). Cortisol AM if adrenal concerns. Reproductive hormones if using very high doses long-term.

Regulatory status: Dietary supplement in US — no FDA drug approval. Available OTC. Melatonin is a hormone — physician consultation recommended for therapeutic high-dose use.

entries.title: 5-Amino-1MQ
entries.subtitle: 5-Amino-1-methylquinolinium, AMQ
entries.text:
5-Amino-1MQ (5-Amino-1-methylquinolinium, AMQ) — Metabolic / Longevity

5-Amino-1MQ is a small molecule inhibitor of NNMT (nicotinamide N-methyltransferase), an enzyme that regulates NAD+ metabolism and fat cell differentiation. By blocking NNMT it raises intracellular NAD+ levels and activates SIRT1, promoting fat oxidation and improving metabolic function. Preclinical research (2021-2026) shows significant fat loss and improved insulin sensitivity. Growing use in longevity and body recomposition protocols.

Reported benefits:
• Elevates intracellular NAD+ levels
• Activates SIRT1 longevity pathway
• Promotes fat oxidation
• Improves insulin sensitivity in models
• Synergistic with NMN/NR
• Oral bioavailability

Risks and trade-offs:
• Limited human clinical data
• Research primarily preclinical
• Long-term safety not established
• Requires compounding pharmacy
• Dosing not standardized
• Potential interactions with NAD+ pathways

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Longevity / Fat Loss: 50-100mg/day — Oral, once daily with food (8 weeks on / 4 weeks off)

Progression: Stack with NMN or NR for synergistic NAD+ elevation. Monitor body composition, energy, and metabolic markers. Best combined with resistance training.

Common protocols:
• Metabolic Stack: 5-Amino-1MQ 50mg/day, NMN 500mg/day, Berberine 500mg 3x/day

Monitoring: Body composition,Fasting glucose / insulin,HbA1c,Energy levels

entries.title: Estriol
entries.subtitle: E3, Oestriol
entries.text:
Estriol (E3, Oestriol) — Female Hormones / BHRT

Estriol is the weakest of the three main estrogens and the predominant estrogen during pregnancy. Used in bioidentical HRT for peri/postmenopausal women. Has shorter receptor binding duration than estradiol and is considered relatively breast-safe. Compounded as topical cream or vaginal preparation. Research supports use for urogenital atrophy, hot flashes, and bone density.

Reported benefits:
• Relieves menopausal symptoms
• Improves vaginal and urogenital health
• Lower systemic exposure than estradiol
• Considered relatively breast-safe
• Improves skin hydration
• Available topical or vaginal

Risks and trade-offs:
• Weaker systemic effect than estradiol
• May require more frequent dosing
• Not FDA approved as standalone oral
• Requires progesterone if uterus intact
• Compounding required
• Individual response variability

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Topical BHRT: 0.5-2mg/day — Topical cream or gel (Ongoing with progesterone)
• Vaginal Atrophy: 0.5mg 3x/week — Vaginal cream or suppository (Maintenance dosing)

Progression: Always pair with progesterone if uterus intact. Dose to symptom relief. Monitor E2, E3, and progesterone.

Common protocols:
• Female BHRT: Estriol 1mg/day topical, Progesterone 100mg oral at night, DHEA 5-10mg/day

Monitoring: Estradiol (E2),Estriol (E3),Progesterone,FSH / LH,Bone density annually,Breast exam / mammogram

entries.title: YK-11
entries.subtitle: YK11, Myostatin inhibitor SARM
entries.text:
YK-11 (YK11, Myostatin inhibitor SARM) — SARMs

YK-11 is a unique steroidal SARM that also functions as a myostatin inhibitor. Myostatin limits muscle growth; blocking it theoretically removes the genetic ceiling on muscle development. Shows strong anabolic activity in vitro and high AR affinity. Despite significant community interest, human clinical trials are absent and long-term safety is unknown.

Reported benefits:
• Dual action: SARM plus myostatin inhibitor
• Potentially removes genetic muscle ceiling
• High anabolic potency in vitro
• Significant anecdotal lean mass gains
• Popular in advanced recomposition cycles
• May spare prostate tissue (early data)

Risks and trade-offs:
• Zero human clinical trials
• Potential hepatotoxicity reported
• Testosterone suppression
• Requires PCT
• Long-term safety unknown
• Difficult to source reliably

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Beginner: 5mg/day — Oral, split dose (6-8 weeks)
• Intermediate: 10-15mg/day — Oral, split dose (8 weeks plus PCT)

Progression: Never use without PCT plan. Monitor LFTs before, during, and after. Start low. Bloodwork at 4 weeks.

Common protocols:
• Recomposition: YK-11 10mg/day, RAD-140 10mg/day, PCT after cycle

Monitoring: Liver function LFTs monthly,Total and Free Testosterone,LH / FSH,Lipid panel,Hematocrit

entries.title: Andarine
entries.subtitle: S-4, GTx-007
entries.text:
Andarine (S-4, GTx-007) — SARMs

Andarine (S-4) is one of the earliest developed SARMs, showing strong affinity for muscle and bone androgen receptors. Produces significant strength and lean mass gains, a hardening effect, and modest fat loss. Notable for a distinctive and reversible side effect: a yellow tint to vision at higher doses that reverses after discontinuation.

Reported benefits:
• Strong anabolic effect on muscle and bone
• Body hardening and vascularity
• Modest fat loss properties
• Relatively fast-acting
• Strength gains often rapid
• Better studied than newer SARMs

Risks and trade-offs:
• Yellow vision tint at higher doses
• Moderate testosterone suppression
• Requires PCT at most doses
• Short half-life requires split dosing
• Vision effects concerning for some
• Limited human safety data

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Beginner: 25mg/day — Oral, split into 2 doses (6-8 weeks)
• Intermediate: 50mg/day — Oral, split doses (8 weeks plus PCT)

Progression: Split dose morning and evening. If yellow vision appears, reduce dose. Always plan PCT before starting.

Common protocols:
• Cutting Stack: Andarine 25-50mg/day, Cardarine 10mg/day, Ostarine 25mg/day

Monitoring: Testosterone,LH / FSH,Lipid panel,Liver function,Vision changes

entries.title: Proviron
entries.subtitle: Mesterolone, 1-Methyl-DHT
entries.text:
Proviron (Mesterolone, 1-Methyl-DHT) — Androgens / TRT

Proviron (mesterolone) is a DHT-derived oral androgen that does not aromatize and reduces estrogen activity by displacing estradiol from SHBG. Increases free testosterone, reduces estrogen, improves libido, and enhances muscle hardness. Unlike most oral AAS it has low hepatotoxicity. Widely used as a TRT adjunct for men with high SHBG or low libido before resorting to aromatase inhibitors.

Reported benefits:
• Increases free testosterone via SHBG displacement
• Does not aromatize
• Anti-estrogenic properties
• Significantly improves libido
• Low hepatotoxicity vs other orals
• Hardens physique and reduces water retention

Risks and trade-offs:
• Can accelerate male pattern baldness
• Not suitable for females
• Mildly suppresses LH
• Reduces HDL cholesterol
• Minimal anabolic effect alone
• Oral dosing requires consistency

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• TRT Adjunct: 25-50mg/day — Oral with meals (Ongoing or cycled)
• Cycle Support: 50-75mg/day — Oral with meals (Duration of cycle)

Progression: Excellent before resorting to AIs for men with high SHBG or low libido on TRT. Monitor free T, SHBG, and E2.

Common protocols:
• TRT Optimization: Testosterone 150mg/wk, Proviron 25-50mg/day, Monitor free T and E2

Monitoring: Free Testosterone,SHBG,Estradiol (E2),Lipid panel,DHT

entries.title: Stanozolol
entries.subtitle: Winstrol, Winny, Stan
entries.text:
Stanozolol (Winstrol, Winny, Stan) — AAS

Stanozolol is a DHT-derived anabolic steroid available in oral and injectable forms. Produces lean, dry muscle without water retention, significant strength increases, and fat loss. Does not aromatize and reduces SHBG. Historically used medically for hereditary angioedema. Popular in cutting phases but oral form is notably hepatotoxic requiring short cycles and liver support.

Reported benefits:
• No aromatization
• Significant strength increases
• Lean dry muscle gains
• Reduces SHBG
• Excellent for cutting
• Oral and injectable options

Risks and trade-offs:
• Highly hepatotoxic especially oral
• Severe joint dryness and pain
• Strongly suppresses testosterone
• Worsens lipid profile and drops HDL
• Not suitable for bulking
• Requires liver support

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Cutting: 25-50mg/day oral or 50mg EOD injectable — Oral or IM (6 weeks maximum)
• Strength: 10-25mg/day — Oral with meals (4-6 weeks)

Progression: Short cycles only due to hepatotoxicity. Monitor LFTs every 2 weeks. TUDCA or UDCA essential. Never exceed 6 weeks oral.

Common protocols:
• Cutting: Testosterone 200mg/wk base, Stanozolol 50mg/day, TUDCA 500mg/day

Monitoring: Liver enzymes LFTs every 2 weeks,Lipid panel HDL,Testosterone,Joint pain,Blood pressure

entries.title: Nandrolone Phenylpropionate
entries.subtitle: NPP, Durabolin, Short Deca
entries.text:
Nandrolone Phenylpropionate (NPP, Durabolin, Short Deca) — AAS

NPP is the shorter ester version of Nandrolone Decanoate offering identical benefits with faster onset and clearance. Nandrolone has a long medical history for treating anemia, muscle wasting, and osteoporosis. Known for significant joint lubrication, lean mass gains, and collagen synthesis support. Faster clearance than Deca allows more control and quicker protocol adjustment.

Reported benefits:
• Significant lean muscle gains
• Notable joint lubrication and reduces pain
• Supports collagen and bone density
• Lower androgenic than testosterone
• Faster clearance than Deca
• Extensive medical research history

Risks and trade-offs:
• Significant testosterone suppression
• Prolactin elevation possible
• Must run with testosterone base
• Long detection time
• Progesterone-related sides possible
• Cabergoline may be needed

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Joint Support: 100-200mg/week — IM injection 2-3x/week (12-16 weeks)
• Mass Building: 300-400mg/week — IM injection 3x/week (12-16 weeks plus PCT)

Progression: Always run with testosterone base. Have cabergoline on hand. Monitor prolactin at 4 weeks. Joint benefit typically felt within 2-3 weeks.

Common protocols:
• Joint Support plus Mass: Testosterone Cypionate 300mg/wk, NPP 200mg/wk, Monitor prolactin monthly

Monitoring: Prolactin monthly,Testosterone,Estradiol,Lipid panel,Hematocrit,Liver function

entries.title: Testosterone Propionate
entries.subtitle: Test Prop, TP
entries.text:
Testosterone Propionate (Test Prop, TP) — Androgens / TRT

Testosterone Propionate is the shortest ester testosterone with a half-life of approximately 2-3 days, requiring every-other-day or daily injections. Provides the fastest onset, most precise dosing control, and quickest clearance of all testosterone esters. Valuable for those who react poorly to longer esters or need rapid protocol adjustment.

Reported benefits:
• Fastest-acting testosterone ester
• Precise dose control
• Clears quickly
• Rapid protocol adjustment possible
• Identical anabolic profile to other esters
• Preferred by some for fewer fluctuation side effects

Risks and trade-offs:
• EOD or daily injections required
• Injection site discomfort common
• More frequent bloodwork
• Water retention fluctuations with EOD
• Higher pin frequency inconvenient
• Same systemic risks as all testosterone

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• TRT: 25-50mg EOD or 15-20mg daily — IM or SubQ (Ongoing)
• Performance: 100mg EOD — IM injection (8-12 weeks)

Progression: Pin at consistent times. Monitor E2 as shorter ester can cause more fluctuation. Ideal for those metabolizing longer esters poorly.

Common protocols:
• TRT Precision: Testosterone Propionate 25mg EOD, Anastrozole only if E2 elevated on labs

Monitoring: Total and Free Testosterone,Estradiol,Hematocrit,PSA men over 40,Lipid panel

entries.title: Boldenone Undecylenate
entries.subtitle: Equipoise, EQ, Bold
entries.text:
Boldenone Undecylenate (Equipoise, EQ, Bold) — AAS

Boldenone Undecylenate (Equipoise) is a modified testosterone derivative known for slow steady lean mass gains, dramatic vascularity, significant appetite increase, and notable red blood cell elevation. Lower aromatization than testosterone makes estrogen management easier. Very long half-life requires once-weekly injection and long cycles of 16-20 weeks for full benefit.

Reported benefits:
• Lean quality gains with minimal water
• Significant vascularity increase
• Raises RBC for endurance and recovery
• Once weekly injection
• Moderate aromatization
• Dramatic appetite useful for hard gainers

Risks and trade-offs:
• Requires very long cycles
• Can raise hematocrit significantly
• High appetite unwanted in cuts
• Very long detection time
• Slow onset under 8 weeks
• Estrogen can become issue at high doses

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Mass / Performance: 300-600mg/week — IM injection once or twice weekly (16-20 weeks plus PCT)
• Lean Mass: 200-300mg/week — IM weekly (16 weeks)

Progression: Monitor hematocrit closely as EQ raises RBC significantly and may require therapeutic phlebotomy. Long cycle requires patience. Plan PCT before starting.

Common protocols:
• Lean Mass: Testosterone Enanthate 400mg/wk, Boldenone 400mg/wk, 16-week cycle

Monitoring: Hematocrit monthly minimum,Hemoglobin,RBC count,Estradiol,Testosterone,Lipid panel

entries.title: Trenbolone Acetate
entries.subtitle: Tren A, Fina
entries.text:
Trenbolone Acetate (Tren A, Fina) — AAS

Trenbolone Acetate is one of the most powerful anabolic steroids available, a 19-nor derivative roughly five times more anabolic and androgenic than testosterone. The acetate ester gives a short half-life requiring frequent injection but rapid clearance. Produces dramatic lean mass, strength, and conditioning with no aromatization. Considered an advanced-only compound due to the severity and frequency of side effects.

Reported benefits:
• Extremely potent — dramatic strength and lean mass
• No aromatization to estrogen
• Powerful nutrient partitioning and fat loss
• Increases IGF-1 and red blood cell production
• Dramatic conditioning and hardening effect
• Short ester allows quick adjustment

Risks and trade-offs:
• Severe — night sweats, insomnia, anxiety
• Tren cough, aggression, mood changes
• Strong libido and erectile issues for many
• Suppresses natural testosterone heavily
• Prolactin and progesterone sides possible
• Cardiovascular and kidney stress — advanced only

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Intermediate: 50mg EOD (175mg/wk) — IM injection every other day (8 weeks max)
• Advanced: 75-100mg EOD — IM injection every other day (8 weeks + full PCT)

Progression: Advanced users only. Never a first cycle. Run with testosterone base. Have cabergoline for prolactin. Monitor mental health closely — discontinue if mood severely affected.

Common protocols:
• Contest Prep: Testosterone Propionate 100mg/wk, Trenbolone Acetate 350mg/wk, Masteron 400mg/wk

Monitoring: Blood pressure — frequent,Lipid panel — HDL crashes,Kidney function,Prolactin,Mental health and sleep,Hematocrit

entries.title: Trenbolone Enanthate
entries.subtitle: Tren E
entries.text:
Trenbolone Enanthate (Tren E) — AAS

Trenbolone Enanthate is the longer-ester version of trenbolone, offering the same extreme potency with a longer half-life allowing twice-weekly injection. Identical effects to the acetate version — dramatic lean mass, strength, conditioning, no aromatization — but blood levels build and clear more slowly, making side effects harder to reverse quickly if they become problematic.

Reported benefits:
• Same potency as Tren Ace, less frequent injection
• Dramatic lean mass and strength
• No aromatization
• Powerful fat loss and conditioning
• Stable blood levels with twice-weekly dosing
• Increases IGF-1

Risks and trade-offs:
• Same severe sides as Tren Ace
• Longer to clear if sides become severe
• Heavy testosterone suppression
• Night sweats, insomnia, anxiety
• Prolactin/progesterone sides
• Advanced users only

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Intermediate: 200mg/week — IM injection 2x/week (10 weeks max)
• Advanced: 300-400mg/week — IM injection 2x/week (10-12 weeks + PCT)

Progression: Advanced only. Run with testosterone. Cabergoline on hand. Monitor mental health and sleep — the longer ester means you commit to the side effects for longer.

Common protocols:
• Lean Bulk: Testosterone Enanthate 300mg/wk, Trenbolone Enanthate 300mg/wk, Proper PCT after

Monitoring: Blood pressure,Lipid panel,Kidney function,Prolactin,Mental health,Hematocrit

entries.title: Methandrostenolone
entries.subtitle: Dianabol, Dbol, D-bol
entries.text:
Methandrostenolone (Dianabol, Dbol, D-bol) — AAS

Methandrostenolone (Dianabol) is a classic oral anabolic steroid famous for rapid, dramatic mass and strength gains. One of the first widely used performance steroids. Works fast — noticeable strength within days — making it popular as a cycle kickstart. Aromatizes readily, causing significant water retention and estrogen-related effects. Hepatotoxic as an oral 17-alpha-alkylated compound, requiring short cycles and liver support.

Reported benefits:
• Rapid, dramatic mass and strength gains
• Fast-acting — results within the first week
• Excellent kickstart to injectable cycles
• Improves protein synthesis and nitrogen retention
• Boosts mood and training intensity
• Inexpensive and widely available

Risks and trade-offs:
• Heavy aromatization — water retention, gyno
• Hepatotoxic — liver stress
• Raises blood pressure significantly
• Strong testosterone suppression
• Gains partly water — some lost after cycle
• Requires AI and liver support

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Beginner: 20-30mg/day — Oral, split through day (4-6 weeks)
• Intermediate: 40-50mg/day — Oral, split through day (4-6 weeks max)

Progression: Kickstart cycle for first 4-6 weeks while injectables build up. Use AI to control estrogen. TUDCA for liver. Monitor blood pressure closely.

Common protocols:
• Mass Kickstart: Testosterone Enanthate 500mg/wk, Dianabol 30mg/day weeks 1-5, Anastrozole as needed, TUDCA 500mg/day

Monitoring: Liver enzymes (LFTs),Blood pressure — often elevated,Estradiol,Lipid panel,Hematocrit

entries.title: Oxymetholone
entries.subtitle: Anadrol, A-bombs, Drol
entries.text:
Oxymetholone (Anadrol, A-bombs, Drol) — AAS

Oxymetholone (Anadrol) is among the most powerful oral steroids for raw mass and strength. Originally developed to treat anemia, it dramatically increases red blood cell production and produces some of the fastest weight gains of any compound. Highly hepatotoxic and estrogenic in effect (despite not aromatizing conventionally), making it one of the harsher orals. Reserved for experienced users during mass phases.

Reported benefits:
• Extreme mass and strength — fastest gainer
• Dramatic increase in red blood cells
• Rapid strength in days
• Improves appetite and pumps
• Useful for breaking plateaus
• Effective for anemia medically

Risks and trade-offs:
• Highly hepatotoxic — among the harshest orals
• Estrogenic effects without aromatization
• Significant water retention
• Blood pressure spikes
• Appetite suppression at high doses (paradoxical)
• Liver support and short cycles mandatory

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Intermediate: 50mg/day — Oral, with food (4 weeks)
• Advanced: 50-100mg/day — Oral, with food (4-6 weeks max)

Progression: Short cycles only. Mandatory liver support (TUDCA/NAC). Monitor LFTs every 2 weeks. Watch blood pressure and hematocrit — donate blood if needed.

Common protocols:
• Mass Phase: Testosterone 500mg/wk, Anadrol 50mg/day weeks 1-4, TUDCA 500mg/day, Telmisartan for BP

Monitoring: Liver enzymes — every 2 weeks,Blood pressure,Hematocrit — often climbs fast,Estradiol effects,Kidney function

entries.title: Chlorodehydromethyltestosterone
entries.subtitle: Turinabol, Tbol, Oral Turinabol
entries.text:
Chlorodehydromethyltestosterone (Turinabol, Tbol, Oral Turinabol) — AAS

Turinabol (Tbol) is an oral steroid derived from Dianabol but modified so it does not aromatize. Produces steady, lean, dry gains without water retention — making it popular for lean mass and recomposition. Milder than Dianabol or Anadrol with a cleaner side effect profile, though still hepatotoxic. Known historically from East German athletic programs. A favorite for those wanting quality gains without bloat.

Reported benefits:
• Lean, dry gains — no water retention
• No aromatization — no estrogen sides
• Milder than Dbol/Anadrol
• Good strength without mass bloat
• Lower androgenic activity
• Popular for recomposition

Risks and trade-offs:
• Hepatotoxic — liver stress
• Suppresses natural testosterone
• Lowers HDL cholesterol
• Gains slower than harsher orals
• Long detection time
• Still requires PCT

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Beginner: 20-30mg/day — Oral, split or once daily (6-8 weeks)
• Intermediate: 40-60mg/day — Oral, split through day (6-8 weeks)

Progression: Cleaner oral option for lean gains. Liver support recommended. Good for first oral experience or recomposition. Standard PCT after.

Common protocols:
• Lean Recomp: Testosterone 300mg/wk, Turinabol 40mg/day, TUDCA 500mg/day

Monitoring: Liver enzymes (LFTs),Lipid panel — HDL,Testosterone,Blood pressure

entries.title: Drostanolone Enanthate
entries.subtitle: Masteron Enanthate, Mast E
entries.text:
Drostanolone Enanthate (Masteron Enanthate, Mast E) — AAS

Drostanolone Enanthate is the longer-ester version of Masteron, a DHT-derived steroid prized for its hardening and anti-estrogenic properties. Does not aromatize and mildly reduces estrogen activity. Produces a dry, hard, defined look — most effective on already-lean physiques. The enanthate ester allows twice-weekly injection versus the every-other-day schedule of the propionate version. Popular in contest prep and cutting cycles.

Reported benefits:
• Hardening and conditioning effect
• Mild anti-estrogenic activity
• No aromatization
• Less frequent injection than Mast Prop
• Adds a dry, defined look
• Can improve libido and well-being

Risks and trade-offs:
• Best results only on lean physiques
• Minimal benefit when not already lean
• DHT-based — accelerates hair loss
• Suppresses natural testosterone
• Lowers HDL
• Not a mass builder

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Cutting: 300-400mg/week — IM injection 2x/week (10-12 weeks)
• Contest Prep: 400-600mg/week — IM injection 2x/week (During prep phase)

Progression: Use during cutting on an already-lean physique for the hardening effect. Pairs well with testosterone and trenbolone. Watch hair loss in susceptible individuals.

Common protocols:
• Contest Prep: Testosterone Propionate 100mg/wk, Masteron Enanthate 400mg/wk, Trenbolone Acetate 350mg/wk

Monitoring: Lipid panel — HDL,Testosterone,DHT and hair,Blood pressure,Hematocrit

entries.title: Methenolone Acetate (Oral)
entries.subtitle: Primobolan Oral, Oral Primo
entries.text:
Methenolone Acetate (Oral) (Primobolan Oral, Oral Primo) — AAS

Oral Methenolone Acetate (Primobolan) is a mild DHT-derived steroid known for clean, lean gains with one of the most favorable side effect profiles of any oral. Does not aromatize and is not 17-alpha-alkylated in the traditional liver-toxic way, making it gentler on the liver than most orals. Popular among those prioritizing safety and quality over raw size. Expensive and frequently counterfeited.

Reported benefits:
• Very mild side effect profile
• No aromatization
• Gentler on liver than most orals
• Lean, quality gains
• Preserves muscle in a deficit
• Mild enough some women use it

Risks and trade-offs:
• Expensive — frequently faked
• Mild — not for dramatic mass
• Still suppresses testosterone somewhat
• Lowers HDL
• Requires higher doses for effect
• Lower bioavailability oral

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Lean Gains: 50-75mg/day — Oral, split through day (8 weeks)
• Cutting: 75-100mg/day — Oral, split through day (8 weeks)

Progression: Quality-over-quantity compound. Excellent for cutting while preserving muscle. Mild enough to pair with TRT-dose testosterone. Verify source — heavily counterfeited.

Common protocols:
• Lean Cut: Testosterone 200mg/wk, Oral Primobolan 75mg/day, Cardio and clean diet

Monitoring: Lipid panel,Testosterone,Liver enzymes (precaution),Blood pressure

entries.title: Testosterone Suspension
entries.subtitle: Test Susp, Aqueous Testosterone
entries.text:
Testosterone Suspension (Test Susp, Aqueous Testosterone) — Androgens / TRT

Testosterone Suspension is pure testosterone in a water base with no ester attached, giving it an immediate onset and very short half-life. Because there is no ester, nearly 100% of the compound is active testosterone by weight. Used primarily as a pre-workout boost or contest-day compound due to its instant action. Requires daily or twice-daily injection and the aqueous base is known for injection site discomfort.

Reported benefits:
• Immediate onset — active within hours
• Nearly 100% testosterone by weight
• Powerful strength and pump boost
• Clears the system quickly
• Useful pre-workout or contest day
• Maximum potency per mg

Risks and trade-offs:
• Daily or twice-daily injection required
• Painful injections (water base)
• Aromatizes — estrogen management needed
• Very short action — frequent dosing
• Impractical for most protocols
• Suppresses natural testosterone

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Pre-Workout: 50-100mg before training — IM injection (As needed)
• Daily Use: 50-100mg/day — IM injection daily (Short cycle)

Progression: Niche compound — most useful as a pre-workout boost or final contest-prep weeks. Not practical for general protocols due to injection frequency and pain. Manage estrogen.

Common protocols:
• Strength Boost: Testosterone Suspension 100mg pre-workout, Standard testosterone base cycle

Monitoring: Estradiol,Testosterone,Hematocrit,Blood pressure

entries.title: Sustanon 250 (Testosterone Blend)
entries.subtitle: Sustanon, Sust, Test Blend
entries.text:
Sustanon 250 (Testosterone Blend) (Sustanon, Sust, Test Blend) — Androgens / TRT

Sustanon 250 is a blend of four testosterone esters — propionate, phenylpropionate, isocaproate, and decanoate — designed to provide both fast onset and sustained release from a single injection. The mix of short and long esters means testosterone enters the bloodstream quickly and continues releasing over about three weeks. Common in both TRT and performance contexts, though many find more stable blood levels with single-ester testosterone dosed frequently.

Reported benefits:
• Fast onset plus long-lasting release
• Single injection covers multiple release rates
• Widely available pharmaceutical grade
• Effective for TRT and performance
• Fewer injections than single short esters
• Same testosterone benefits overall

Risks and trade-offs:
• Blood levels less stable than single ester
• Decanoate component lingers — slow to clear
• Aromatizes — estrogen management
• Suppresses natural testosterone
• Frequent injection still ideal for stability
• Can complicate fine-tuning

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• TRT: 125-250mg/week — IM injection 1-2x/week (Ongoing)
• Performance: 250-500mg/week — IM injection 2x/week (12-16 weeks + PCT)

Progression: For stable levels, inject at least twice weekly rather than the traditional single weekly shot. Manage estrogen with an AI as needed. Standard testosterone monitoring.

Common protocols:
• Mass Cycle: Sustanon 500mg/wk, Optional oral kickstart, Anastrozole as needed, PCT after

Monitoring: Total and Free Testosterone,Estradiol,Hematocrit,PSA (men 40+),Lipid panel

entries.title: SLU-PP-332
entries.subtitle: SLU-PP-332, Exercise Mimetic
entries.text:
SLU-PP-332 (SLU-PP-332, Exercise Mimetic) — Metabolic / Longevity

SLU-PP-332 is a research compound known as an 'exercise mimetic' — a pan-ERR (estrogen-related receptor) agonist that activates the same metabolic pathways triggered by endurance exercise. In preclinical rodent studies (2023-2026) it increased fat oxidation, improved endurance, and produced fat loss without changes to food intake or activity level. Entirely investigational with no human data — it represents an emerging class of compounds that aim to deliver exercise-like metabolic benefits pharmacologically.

Reported benefits:
• Activates exercise-like metabolic pathways
• Increased fat oxidation in studies
• Improved endurance capacity (rodent data)
• Fat loss without appetite change in models
• Novel pan-ERR agonist mechanism
• Significant interest in metabolic research

Risks and trade-offs:
• No human studies whatsoever
• Entirely preclinical / experimental
• Long-term safety completely unknown
• No established human dosing
• Research chemical — purity varies
• Not a substitute for actual exercise

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Research Only: No established human dose — Investigational (No human protocols exist)

Progression: Purely experimental research compound with zero human data. Any use is self-experimentation with unknown risks. Mentioned here for educational completeness as an emerging metabolic compound. Real exercise remains the proven path.

Common protocols:
• Research Context: SLU-PP-332 (investigational), No validated stack exists

Monitoring: No established monitoring,Experimental — caution advised

entries.title: Raloxifene
entries.subtitle: Evista
entries.text:
Raloxifene (Evista) — Ancillaries — AIs and SERMs

Raloxifene is a SERM (selective estrogen receptor modulator) considered one of the most effective compounds for treating gynecomastia, particularly established or stubborn gyno. It blocks estrogen at breast tissue receptors more effectively than tamoxifen for reversing existing gland growth. Also used for bone density. In the performance context it is the go-to for managing or attempting to reverse gyno that has already developed.

Reported benefits:
• Most effective SERM for existing gyno
• Can reverse established gland tissue
• Blocks estrogen at breast receptors
• Supports bone mineral density
• Does not lower estrogen systemically
• Well tolerated by most

Risks and trade-offs:
• Does not prevent estrogen conversion
• Risk of blood clots (SERM class)
• Not a substitute for an AI on cycle
• Best for gyno, not general estrogen control
• Can cause hot flashes, leg cramps
• Requires consistent dosing for gyno

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Active Gyno: 60mg/day — Oral (Until resolved, then taper)
• Maintenance: 30-60mg/day — Oral (As needed)

Progression: First-line for reversing existing gynecomastia. Start at 60mg/day when gyno appears, reduce as tissue shrinks. Combine with an AI to control the underlying estrogen on cycle.

Common protocols:
• Gyno Reversal: Raloxifene 60mg/day, Anastrozole to control E2, Address the cause on cycle

Monitoring: Breast tissue changes,Estradiol,Signs of clotting (calf pain, swelling),Liver function

entries.title: Isotretinoin
entries.subtitle: Accutane, Roaccutane, Tretinoin (oral)
entries.text:
Isotretinoin (Accutane, Roaccutane, Tretinoin (oral)) — Side Effect Management

Isotretinoin (Accutane) is the most powerful treatment for severe acne, including the steroid-induced acne that affects many on androgen cycles. It works by dramatically shrinking sebaceous glands and reducing oil production. Highly effective but with a significant side effect profile requiring medical supervision and bloodwork. The definitive solution for severe cystic acne when topical and antibiotic treatments fail.

Reported benefits:
• Most effective acne treatment available
• Resolves severe cystic and steroid acne
• Often produces permanent remission
• Dramatically reduces oil production
• Works when nothing else does
• Defined treatment course

Risks and trade-offs:
• Significant side effects — requires monitoring
• Severe birth defects — never during pregnancy
• Dry skin, lips, eyes; joint aches
• Can raise liver enzymes and lipids
• Mood changes reported
• Requires regular bloodwork and prescription

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Low-Dose (common for AAS acne): 10-20mg/day — Oral with fatty meal (Several months under MD)
• Standard: 0.5-1mg/kg/day — Oral with fatty meal (15-20 week course)

Progression: Prescription and medical supervision required. Low-dose protocols are popular for managing steroid-induced acne with fewer side effects. Always take with dietary fat for absorption. Monitor liver and lipids.

Common protocols:
• Acne Management: Isotretinoin 20mg/day, Liver support, Lipid monitoring, Address E2 if hormonal acne

entries.title: Bromocriptine
entries.subtitle: Parlodel, Bromo
entries.text:
Bromocriptine (Parlodel, Bromo) — Ancillaries — AIs and SERMs

Bromocriptine is a dopamine agonist used to control elevated prolactin, an older alternative to cabergoline. Prolactin can rise with 19-nor compounds like trenbolone and nandrolone, causing sexual dysfunction, lactation, and gyno-like symptoms. Bromocriptine lowers prolactin effectively but has more side effects (nausea, dizziness) than cabergoline, which is why caber is generally preferred when available.

Reported benefits:
• Effectively lowers elevated prolactin
• Useful with 19-nor compounds (tren, deca)
• Resolves prolactin sexual dysfunction
• Cheaper and more available than caber
• Can aid fat loss slightly
• Long medical track record

Risks and trade-offs:
• More side effects than cabergoline
• Nausea, dizziness, fatigue common
• Shorter half-life — more frequent dosing
• Cabergoline generally superior
• Can cause low blood pressure
• Take with food to reduce nausea

Dosing discussed in the literature:
• Prolactin Control: 2.5mg/day — Oral with food (While on 19-nor compounds)

Progression: Use when prolactin is elevated on nandrolone or trenbolone cycles. Cabergoline is preferred if available due to fewer side effects, but bromocriptine works. Take with food.

Common protocols:
• 19-Nor Support: Bromocriptine 2.5mg/day, On deca or tren cycles, Monitor prolactin labs

Monitoring: Prolactin levels,Blood pressure,Nausea / tolerance
